name: Two-stage empirical Bayes normal means with estimated standard errors
model_likelihood: Normal effect-estimate sampling and scaled chi-squared estimated-variance sampling; moderated conditional t likelihood
prior: Inverse-gamma latent variances; baseline effect prior g_beta in G
inference_algorithm: Method-of-moments variance-prior fit and moderation, then EB t-means effect-prior fit
data_input: Effect estimates, estimated standard errors, sampling degrees of freedom
tunable_settings: Effect-prior family G; scaled-effect exponent alpha (0 for baseline, optionally estimated by likelihood comparison)

name: Empirical Bayes t-means model (EBTM)
model_likelihood: Conditional t effect-estimate likelihood with supplied scale and degrees of freedom; moderated values in the proposed procedure
prior: Common effect distribution g_beta in a specified family G
inference_algorithm: Estimate g_beta and compute conditional effect posterior distributions
data_input: Effect estimates, supplied standard errors and degrees of freedom
tunable_settings: Effect-prior family G; scaled-effect exponent alpha
